table.name: frpm
table.purpose: California Department of Education Free or Reduced-Price Meals (FRPM) / National School Lunch Program eligibility data for the 2014-2015 academic year, one row per California public school (identified by its 14-digit CDS code). For each school it records enrollment, counts and percentages of students eligible for free meals and free/reduced-price meals (both for K-12 and for ages 5-17), plus school, district, and county identification and charter/NSLP-provision attributes. The CDSCode links to the schools and satscores tables.

2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Sta.name: calpads_fall1_certified
2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Sta.description: Flag indicating the school's CALPADS Fall 1 enrollment submission was certified (1 = certified) for the 2013-14 reporting year. Constant value 1 across all rows, so it carries no discriminating information here.

Academic Year.name: academic_year
Academic Year.description: Academic year of the FRPM data; constant '2014-2015' for all rows.

CDSCode.name: cds_code
CDSCode.description: California Department of Education 14-digit County-District-School (CDS) code, the unique identifier for each school record; primary key of this table and the natural join key to the schools and satscores tables.

Charter Funding Type.name: charter_funding_type
Charter Funding Type.description: Funding model for charter schools: 'Directly funded' (receives state funds directly) or 'Locally funded' (funds flow through the district). Null for non-charter schools (~88% of rows); 'Not in CS funding model' for one anomalous record.

Charter School (Y/N).name: is_charter
Charter School (Y/N).description: Boolean flag: 1 if the school is a charter school, 0 otherwise (about 12% are charters).

Charter School Number.name: charter_school_number
Charter School Number.description: State-assigned charter school number (4-character code, e.g. '00D2', '0756'). Populated only for charter schools; null otherwise.

County Code.name: county_code
County Code.description: Two-digit California county code (1-58), the first component of the CDS code; e.g. 19 = Los Angeles, 37 = San Diego.

County Name.name: county_name
County Name.description: Name of the California county in which the school's district is located.

District Code.name: district_code
District Code.description: Five-digit code of the school district (LEA), the second component of the CDS code.

District Name.name: district_name
District Name.description: Name of the school district / local educational agency (e.g. 'Los Angeles Unified').

District Type.name: district_type
District Type.description: Type of local educational agency: Unified School District, Elementary School District, High School District, County Office of Education, State Board of Education, etc.

Educational Option Type.name: educational_option_type
Educational Option Type.description: Program/educational option served by the school: Traditional, Continuation School, Alternative School of Choice, Community Day School, Special Education School, Juvenile Court School, Home and Hospital, etc.

Enrollment (Ages 5-17).name: enrollment_ages_5_17
Enrollment (Ages 5-17).description: Number of students enrolled at the school aged 5-17 (the age range used for some FRPM funding calculations).

Enrollment (K-12).name: enrollment_k_12
Enrollment (K-12).description: Total kindergarten-through-grade-12 enrollment at the school.

FRPM Count (Ages 5-17).name: frpm_count_ages_5_17
FRPM Count (Ages 5-17).description: Number of enrolled students aged 5-17 eligible for Free or Reduced-Price Meals (FRPM) under the National School Lunch Program.

FRPM Count (K-12).name: frpm_count_k_12
FRPM Count (K-12).description: Number of K-12 students eligible for Free or Reduced-Price Meals.

Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17).name: free_meal_count_ages_5_17
Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17).description: Number of enrolled students aged 5-17 eligible for free meals (a subset of FRPM eligibility, excluding reduced-price-only students).

Free Meal Count (K-12).name: free_meal_count_k_12
Free Meal Count (K-12).description: Number of K-12 students eligible for free meals (subset of FRPM count).

High Grade.name: high_grade
High Grade.description: Highest grade level offered at the school ('K', '1'-'12', '13' for ungraded/adult).

IRC.name: irc_flag
IRC.description: Boolean flag, likely 'Is Residential Child-Care institution' (or similar IRC designation relevant to NSLP meal programs); 1 for about 7% of schools. Exact expansion of the acronym is not evidenced in the data.

Low Grade.name: low_grade
Low Grade.description: Lowest grade level offered at the school: 'P' (preschool/pre-K), 'K', or '1'-'12'.

NSLP Provision Status.name: nslp_provision_status
NSLP Provision Status.description: National School Lunch Program provision status of the school: Provision 1/2/3, Breakfast Provision 2, or CEP (Community Eligibility Provision) — alternative meal-counting rules that allow serving free meals to all students. Null for schools not under a special provision.

Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17).name: pct_eligible_frpm_ages_5_17
Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17).description: Share of enrolled students aged 5-17 eligible for free or reduced-price meals, stored as a fraction (0-1) despite the '%' in the column name; equals FRPM Count (Ages 5-17) / Enrollment (Ages 5-17).

Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12).name: pct_eligible_frpm_k_12
Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12).description: Share of K-12 enrollment eligible for free or reduced-price meals, stored as a fraction (0-1); equals FRPM Count (K-12) / Enrollment (K-12).

Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17).name: pct_eligible_free_ages_5_17
Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17).description: Share of enrolled students aged 5-17 eligible for free meals, stored as a fraction (0-1); equals Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17) / Enrollment (Ages 5-17).

Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12).name: pct_eligible_free_k_12
Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12).description: Share of K-12 enrollment eligible for free meals, stored as a fraction (0-1); equals Free Meal Count (K-12) / Enrollment (K-12).

School Code.name: school_code
School Code.description: Seven-digit school code, the third component of the CDS code; '0000000' for non-school locations such as district offices.

School Name.name: school_name
School Name.description: Name of the school (or 'District Office' for district-level records).

School Type.name: school_type
School Type.description: CDE school type classification: Elementary Schools (Public), High Schools (Public), Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public), Continuation High Schools, Alternative Schools of Choice, etc.

table.name: satscores
table.purpose: California SAT results (old 3-section SAT, 2400 scale) per school and district: grade-12 enrollment, number of test takers, average section scores, and count of test takers scoring 1500+. Each row is a school (rtype='S') or district (rtype='D') identified by its CDS code, which links to the schools table. Score columns are null when no scores were reported (e.g., too few test takers).

AvgScrMath.name: AvgScrMath
AvgScrMath.description: Average SAT mathematics section score for the entity's test takers (old 3-section SAT, scale 200–800). Null when no scores reported (e.g., too few test takers or rtype=D rows without data).

AvgScrRead.name: AvgScrRead
AvgScrRead.description: Average SAT critical reading section score (scale 200–800) for the entity's test takers; null when not reported.

AvgScrWrite.name: AvgScrWrite
AvgScrWrite.description: Average SAT writing section score (scale 200–800) for the entity's test takers; null when not reported.

NumGE1500.name: NumGE1500
NumGE1500.description: Number of test takers whose combined SAT score met or exceeded 1500 (out of 2400 on the old 3-section SAT). Null when scores not reported.

NumTstTakr.name: NumTstTakr
NumTstTakr.description: Number of SAT test takers at the school/district. Zero often means no grade-12 test takers; never null.

cds.name: cds
cds.description: CDS code (County-District-School), the California 14-digit identifier for the school or district; unique per row and joins one-to-one to schools.CDSCode.

cname.name: cname
cname.description: County name (California county, e.g., Los Angeles, San Diego).

dname.name: dname
dname.description: District name (school district or county office of education).

rtype.name: rtype
rtype.description: Record type: 'S' = school-level record (sname populated), 'D' = district-level aggregate (sname null).

sname.name: sname
sname.description: School name; null for district-level (rtype='D') rows.

table.name: schools
table.purpose: Directory of California public schools (including closed and merged ones), one row per school, keyed by the 14-digit CDE CDS code. Contains location and mailing addresses, district and county, school type/grade-span codes, charter and magnet flags, administrator contact details, and open/close dates. Referenced by satscores (per-school SAT results) and related to frpm (free/reduced-price meal data).

AdmEmail1.name: Administrator 1 Email
AdmEmail1.description: Email address of the school's first administrator (principal/director) on record

AdmEmail2.name: Administrator 2 Email
AdmEmail2.description: Email address of the school's second administrator on record

AdmEmail3.name: Administrator 3 Email
AdmEmail3.description: Email address of the school's third administrator on record

AdmFName1.name: Administrator 1 First Name
AdmFName1.description: First name of the school's first administrator

AdmFName2.name: Administrator 2 First Name
AdmFName2.description: First name of the school's second administrator

AdmFName3.name: Administrator 3 First Name
AdmFName3.description: First name of the school's third administrator

AdmLName1.name: Administrator 1 Last Name
AdmLName1.description: Last name of the school's first administrator

AdmLName2.name: Administrator 2 Last Name
AdmLName2.description: Last name of the school's second administrator

AdmLName3.name: Administrator 3 Last Name
AdmLName3.description: Last name of the school's third administrator

CDSCode.name: CDS Code
CDSCode.description: California Department of Education 14-digit County-District-School code; unique identifier for the school, primary key of this table. Joins one-to-one to satscores.cds

Charter.name: Charter School Flag
Charter.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the school is a charter school (1 = yes, 0 = no)

CharterNum.name: Charter Number
CharterNum.description: State-assigned charter school number (4-digit, zero-padded); populated only for charter schools

City.name: City
City.description: City in which the school's physical site is located

ClosedDate.name: Closed Date
ClosedDate.description: Date the school closed (or was merged); null for active schools. Range 1980-2016

County.name: County
County.description: California county in which the school is located (58 counties)

DOC.name: District Ownership Code
DOC.description: District Ownership Code: 2-digit code for the type of district operating the school (e.g. 54 = unified, 52 = elementary, 00 = county office)

DOCType.name: District Ownership Type
DOCType.description: Plain-text label for DOC, e.g. 'Unified School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)'

District.name: District Name
District.description: Name of the school district (or county office of education / charter authorizer) operating the school

EILCode.name: Educational Instruction Level Code
EILCode.description: Educational Instruction Level code: the grade-level span category of the school (ELEM, HS, UG, INTMIDJR, ELEMHIGH, A, PS)

EILName.name: Educational Instruction Level Name
EILName.description: Plain-text label for EILCode, e.g. 'Elementary', 'High School', 'Ungraded'

EdOpsCode.name: Educational Options Code
EdOpsCode.description: Educational Options code: type of educational program (TRAD = traditional, CON = continuation, COMMDAY = community day, ALTSOC, SPEC, ROP, YTH, HOMHOS, JUV, etc.)

EdOpsName.name: Educational Options Name
EdOpsName.description: Plain-text label for EdOpsCode, e.g. 'Traditional', 'Continuation School', 'Juvenile Court School'

Ext.name: Phone Extension
Ext.description: Telephone extension for the school's main phone number; some values appear to be full numbers or malformed entries

FundingType.name: Charter Funding Type
FundingType.description: Charter school funding model: 'Directly funded' or 'Locally funded' by the sponsoring district; 'Not in CS funding model' for non-charters

GSoffered.name: Grades Offered
GSoffered.description: Range of grade levels offered by the school, e.g. 'K-5', '9-12', 'K-8'; single values like '10' or 'P' (preschool) also occur

GSserved.name: Grades Served
GSserved.description: Range of grade levels actually served by the school (may differ slightly from grades offered)

LastUpdate.name: Last Update Date
LastUpdate.description: Date the school's directory record was last updated (1999-2016)

Latitude.name: Latitude
Latitude.description: Geographic latitude of the school site (decimal degrees, WGS84); range 32.5-44.2 consistent with California

Longitude.name: Longitude
Longitude.description: Geographic longitude of the school site (decimal degrees, negative = west); range -124.3 to -83.8, mostly within California

Magnet.name: Magnet School Flag
Magnet.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the school is a magnet school (1 = yes, 0 = no)

MailCity.name: Mailing City
MailCity.description: City of the school's mailing address

MailState.name: Mailing State
MailState.description: State of the school's mailing address; always 'CA'

MailStrAbr.name: Mailing Street (Abbreviated)
MailStrAbr.description: Street portion of the school's mailing address, with abbreviated street types ('Dr.', 'St.', 'Ave.')

MailStreet.name: Mailing Street
MailStreet.description: Street portion of the school's mailing address, spelled out in full

MailZip.name: Mailing ZIP Code
MailZip.description: ZIP code (sometimes ZIP+4) of the school's mailing address

NCESDist.name: NCES District ID
NCESDist.description: 7-digit NCES (National Center for Education Statistics) district ID; leading '06' is California's FIPS state code

NCESSchool.name: NCES School ID
NCESSchool.description: 5-digit NCES school ID within its district; combined with NCESDist forms the federal school identifier

OpenDate.name: Open Date
OpenDate.description: Date the school opened; 1980-07-01 is a default/placeholder for older schools. Range 1850-2017

Phone.name: Phone Number
Phone.description: School's main telephone number in '(area) NNN-NNNN' format

SOC.name: School Type Code (SOC)
SOC.description: School Ownership Code: 2-digit code for the type of school (60 = elementary public, 66 = high school, 62 = middle school, 09 = special education, 70 = adult education, etc.)

SOCType.name: School Type Name
SOCType.description: Plain-text label for SOC, e.g. 'Elementary Schools (Public)', 'Continuation High Schools'

School.name: School Name
School.description: Name of the school (not unique; many 'Lincoln Elementary' etc.)

State.name: State
State.description: State of the school's physical location; always 'CA'

StatusType.name: Status Type
StatusType.description: Administrative status of the school: Active, Closed, Merged, or Pending

Street.name: Street Address
Street.description: Street portion of the school's physical location address, spelled out in full

StreetAbr.name: Street Address (Abbreviated)
StreetAbr.description: Street portion of the school's physical location address, with abbreviated street types

Virtual.name: Virtual School Indicator
Virtual.description: Whether the school offers virtual/online instruction: N = not virtual, P = primarily virtual (or partially), F = fully virtual. Exact CDE coding of P vs F is not verifiable from the data alone

Zip.name: ZIP Code
Zip.description: ZIP code (sometimes ZIP+4) of the school's physical location
